extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and developers performing computational group theory (advanced users)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP functions and properties related to 1- and 2-cohomology, Schur covers, tests for available methods, normalizer techniques, and creation/efficiency/operations of group homomorphisms. Intended to guide correct usage, preconditions, options, and performance considerations within GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: cocycleToComplement
rubrics_metrics.description: Function that takes a cocycle (from OneCocycles) and returns the corresponding complement to M in G (with respect to the fixed complement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to convert a cocycle representation into an explicit complement subgroup. Example usage shown in the manual; complements and generators are returned as Group objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: complementToCocycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Function that takes a complement subgroup and returns the corresponding cocycle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts an explicit complement back into the cocycle vector representation. Examples demonstrate equality checks with Z(p)*vectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: special_methods_for_factor_given_by_pcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: If the factor G/M is given by a (modulo) pcgs gens then special methods compute a presentation for the factor implicitly from the pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When factor is provided via (modulo) pcgs, GAP uses specialized routines to avoid explicit presentation construction; improves efficiency and correctness when pcgs available.

rubrics_metrics.name: one_cocycles_and_one_coboundaries_vector_space
rubrics_metrics.description: The groups of 1-cocycles and 1-coboundaries are represented as vector spaces (not as Group class values) in GAP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are vector spaces over the coefficient field (e.g., GF(p)); users should treat them as linear spaces (bases, complements) rather than Group objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: H1_representation_as_vector_space_complement
rubrics_metrics.description: H1(G/M, M) = Z1(G/M, M)/B1(G/M, M) is represented as a vector space complement to B1 in Z1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no explicit function returning H1 as a Group object; representing cohomology as a complement of coboundaries in cocycles is the recommended approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: stop_early_if_extension_cannot_split_OCOneCocycles
rubrics_metrics.description: OCOneCocycles(ocr, onlySplit) can stop calculations early and return false as soon as possible if the extension does not split when onlySplit is true.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OCOneCocycles is a more technical routine that accepts a record with components 'group' and 'modulePcgs'; components such as oneCoboundaries are computed only if absent. Use onlySplit=true to short-circuit when only splitting detection is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComplementClassesRepresentativesEA
rubrics_metrics.description: ComplementClassesRepresentativesEA(G, N) computes complement classes to an elementary abelian normal subgroup N via 1-cohomology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For general solvable N, users should normally call ComplementClassesRepresentatives (39.11.6) which handles more cases; this EA-specific routine is specialized for elementary abelian normal subgroups.

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoCoh
rubrics_metrics.description: Info class for cohomology calculations is InfoCoh.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use InfoCoh to enable/inspect verbose informational output related to cohomology computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: EpimorphismSchurCover
rubrics_metrics.description: EpimorphismSchurCover(G[, pl]) returns an epimorphism epi from a Schur cover D onto G; the kernel of epi is the Schur multiplier. If pl (list of primes) given, only multiplier parts for these primes are realized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: D is represented as a finitely presented group. Use EpimorphismSchurCover when relation to G is needed (as opposed to SchurCover which returns only D). For large groups calculations may be expensive or unfeasible.

rubrics_metrics.name: SchurCover
rubrics_metrics.description: SchurCover(G) returns one (of possibly several) Schur covers of G, represented as a finitely presented group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To get the epimorphism relating the cover to G, use EpimorphismSchurCover. Converting to permutation group requires IsomorphismPermGroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: AbelianInvariantsMultiplier
rubrics_metrics.description: AbelianInvariantsMultiplier(G) returns a list of the abelian invariants of the Schur multiplier of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This operation does not provide how to extend the multiplier to a Schur cover. For larger groups use SchurMultiplier from the cohomolo package or methods from the Polycyclic package for pcp-groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Epicentre_ExteriorCentre_definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Epicentre(G) / ExteriorCentre(G): epicentre is the smallest normal subgroup N of G such that G/N is a central quotient; equals the exterior center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two attribute names are provided; they give equivalent descriptions and can be used depending on preferred terminology.

rubrics_metrics.name: NonabelianExteriorSquare
rubrics_metrics.description: NonabelianExteriorSquare(G) computes the nonabelian exterior square G ∧ G; for finitely presented groups this equals derived subgroup of a Schur cover.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for deriving invariants related to Schur multipliers and nonabelian homological constructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: EpimorphismNonabelianExteriorSquare
rubrics_metrics.description: EpimorphismNonabelianExteriorSquare(G) computes the mapping G ∧ G → G; the kernel of this map equals the Schur multiplier of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the morphism whose kernel identifies the multiplier; useful when explicit map information is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCentralFactor
rubrics_metrics.description: IsCentralFactor(G) determines whether there exists H with G ≅ H / Z(H) (i.e., whether G is capable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalently checks whether the epicentre of G is trivial. Returns property boolean.

rubrics_metrics.name: BasicSpinRepresentationOfSymmetricGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: BasicSpinRepresentationOfSymmetricGroup(n, p, sign) constructs image of Coxeter generators in the basic spin (projective) representation of SymmetricGroup(n) over a field of characteristic p; sign selects between two representations (+1 or -1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defaults: sign=+1, p=3. Note: convention for labeling +1/-1 is inconsistent in the literature; sign controls order of preimage of adjacent transposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: SchurCoverOfSymmetricGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: SchurCoverOfSymmetricGroup(n, p, sign) constructs a Schur cover of SymmetricGroup(n) as a faithful, irreducible matrix group in characteristic p (p ≠ 2); sign chooses between two covers for n ≥ 4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For n ≤ 3 symmetric group is its own Schur cover and sign ignored. For p=2 fail is returned unless n∈{1,3}. Field is generally GF(p^2) for p>0 and an abelian number field for p=0.

rubrics_metrics.name: DoubleCoverOfAlternatingGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: DoubleCoverOfAlternatingGroup(n, p) constructs a double cover of AlternatingGroup(n) as a faithful, completely reducible matrix group in characteristic p (p ≠ 2) for n ≥ 4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For n ≤ 3 fail. For p=2 fail. Default p=3. Field choices similar to Schur cover functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: TwoCohomologyGeneric
rubrics_metrics.description: TwoCohomologyGeneric(G, M) computes the second cohomology group for finite G with module M; returns record with 'coboundaries', 'cocycles' and 'cohomology' lists of basis vectors, with cohomology chosen as a vector space complement to coboundaries in cocycles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vectors represent tails in M wrt relators of the presentation chosen by routine. Extensions corresponding to cocycle c can be constructed with FpGroupCocycle(r,c). Computation is performed as finitely presented groups; sizes can be large.

rubrics_metrics.name: FpGroupCocycle
rubrics_metrics.description: FpGroupCocycle(r, c[, doperm]) returns a finitely presented group extension corresponding to cocycle vector c from cohomology record r.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If doperm=true a faithful permutation representation is computed and stored in IsomorphismPermGroup attribute. Option normalform=true makes arithmetic bring words into normal form. The last d generators (d = module dimension) generate the normal subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: tests_for_availability_of_methods_general
rubrics_metrics.description: Filters/operations (e.g., CanEasilyTestMembership, CanComputeSize) indicate GAP's capability to perform certain operations for a given group; they return true if good algorithms are available, false if no method or methods may fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are 'other filters' (not properties) and are used in method selection to decide feasibility. Absence does not prove impossibility; availability may change with additional information about the group.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanEasilyTestMembership
rubrics_metrics.description: CanEasilyTestMembership(G): indicates whether GAP can test membership of elements in G in reasonable time (used to decide if algorithms relying on membership tests may be used).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If false, avoid algorithms depending on fast membership testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanEasilyComputeWithIndependentGensAbelianGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: CanEasilyComputeWithIndependentGensAbelianGroup(G): indicates whether GAP can compute independent abelian generators and decompose elements wrt them in reasonable time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used when algorithms require independent abelian generators and exponent decomposition via IndependentGeneratorsOfAbelianGroup and IndependentGeneratorExponents.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanComputeSize_and_variants
rubrics_metrics.description: CanComputeSize(dom) and CanComputeSizeAnySubgroup(G) indicate whether GAP can compute size of domain or any subgroup reasonably easily; CanComputeIndex(G,H) indicates whether index [G:H] can be computed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for algorithm selection where size/index computations are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanComputeIsSubset
rubrics_metrics.description: CanComputeIsSubset(A, B): indicates that GAP can test whether B is a subset of A.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in method selection to decide if subset tests should be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: KnowsHowToDecompose
rubrics_metrics.description: KnowsHowToDecompose(G[, gens]) tests whether G can decompose elements in the generators gens (or default generators) into words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines feasibility of constructing homomorphisms by images (image computation needs decomposition); returns true for arbitrary permutation groups, Pc groups, or some finitely presented groups with given images.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalizerViaRadical_usage
rubrics_metrics.description: NormalizerViaRadical(G, S) implements a particular Normalizer computation approach following the SolvableRadical paradigm; provided as a separate function (not automatic) and may be superior in certain hard cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This specialized routine can be substantially faster for non-solvable groups with nontrivial radical, but may be slower in typical cases—provided for advanced users as a non-automated tool.

rubrics_metrics.name: ways_to_create_group_homomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary methods to create homomorphisms: (1) GroupHomomorphismByImages (give images of generators); (2) GroupHomomorphismByFunction (give image function, optionally inverse); (3) epimorphisms via NaturalHomomorphismByNormalSubgroup; (4) ActionHomomorphism (homomorphisms induced by actions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose creation method based on available data (generator images vs function vs induced action). Each method has different costs and checks; see NC variants to skip expensive tests when the user can guarantee correctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupHomomorphismByImages_contracts_and_tests
rubrics_metrics.description: GroupHomomorphismByImages(G, H[[, gens], imgs]) returns a homomorphism mapping gens of G to imgs in H; defaults to GeneratorsOfGroup if gens/imgs omitted; if H omitted mapping considered surjective. The routine tests that gens generate G and mapping extends to a homomorphism; returns fail if not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The test can be expensive (presentation construction and relator evaluation). Use GroupHomomorphismByImagesNC to avoid tests if the user knows conditions hold.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupHomomorphismByImagesNC_behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: GroupHomomorphismByImagesNC behaves like GroupHomomorphismByImages but omits tests whether gens generate G and whether mapping extends to a homomorphism; faster but results unpredictable if conditions do not hold.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when performance matters and the user can ensure validity of inputs to avoid the expensive checking step.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupGeneralMappingByImages_variants
rubrics_metrics.description: GroupGeneralMappingByImages(G, H, gens, imgs) and NC variants return a general mapping defined by extending gens->imgs homomorphically; NC version does not test containment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GroupHomomorphismByImages creates a general mapping and then tests with IsMapping; use general mapping when multi-valued mappings or unchecked cases are intended.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupHomomorphismByFunction_contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: GroupHomomorphismByFunction(S, R, fun[, invfun]) returns homomorphism mapping s∈S to fun(s). If invfun given, hom is bijection and invfun provides preimages; alternative signatures allow prefun for single preimage when not bijective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No test is performed that the functions indeed define a homomorphism (which would require full multiplication table). Mapping is created as IsSPGeneralMapping; speed trade-offs depend on provided functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsGroupGeneralMappingByImages
rubrics_metrics.description: AsGroupGeneralMappingByImages(map) returns a group general mapping implementing the same abstract mapping as map; some operations may be more effective in this representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to convert mappings into representations with better algorithmic support (e.g., for efficient kernel/image computations).

rubrics_metrics.name: operations_applicable_to_group_homomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: All mapping operations/properties (Image, PreImage, KernelOfMultiplicativeGeneralMapping, Source, Range, IsInjective, IsSurjective, etc.) are applicable to group homomorphisms, with many specialized and more efficient methods available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kernel computation uses KernelOfMultiplicativeGeneralMapping. Homomorphisms can be used to transfer calculations between representations and to obtain isomorphic groups with better algorithms.

rubrics_metrics.name: efficiency_recommendation_set_is_mapping
rubrics_metrics.description: For efficiency it is recommended to tell a mapping that it is a homomorphism (via SetIsMapping) or to create it with GroupHomomorphismByImagesNC to avoid expensive checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This helps GAP choose faster algorithms; avoid unnecessary automatic checks when user can guarantee homomorphism correctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: images_from_generators_effort
rubrics_metrics.description: When mappings are given on generators, computing images requires expressing elements of the source as words in generators; if decomposition is not feasible (KnowsHowToDecompose returns false), computing images may involve expensive elementwise span computation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preimage computation and homomorphism testing have analogous costs. If decomposition is expensive, consider alternative representations or NC variants when safe.

rubrics_metrics.name: action_homomorphisms_performance_tips
rubrics_metrics.description: For action-induced homomorphisms, image computation is often dominated by locating the image in the list of domain elements; sorting the domain list (if efficient comparison defined) can improve performance. GAP assumes acting function implements a proper action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once images of generating set are computed, preimages and kernel behave like GroupHomomorphismByImages. Avoid unnecessary domain conversions.

rubrics_metrics.name: mappings_by_functions_preimage_cost
rubrics_metrics.description: For mappings defined by functions, computing images is governed by the provided function; if no preimage function is given, computing preimages requires mapping every element of the source (expensive in time and memory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide invfun/prefun when feasible to avoid full-domain searches for preimages.

rubrics_metrics.name: kernel_and_presentation_requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Computing the kernel of a homomorphism (unless injective) typically requires the capability to compute a presentation of the image and to evaluate relators of this presentation in preimages of the presentation generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kernel computations can be expensive; ensure necessary capabilities (presentation, preimage computation) are available or use approximations/representations that avoid full kernel computation.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesSmallestGenerators_for_comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: ImagesSmallestGenerators(map) returns images of GeneratorsSmallest(Source(map)); this list can be used to compare group homomorphisms more efficiently than comparing on all source elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this attribute to speed up homomorphism comparisons, relying on smallest generators to imply correctness on full group.

rubrics_metrics.name: tricks_for_very_large_group_homomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: For huge source groups: compute only images (or PreImagesRepresentative) instead of full images/subgroup preimages; create action homomorphisms as 'surjective' to avoid range being set to full symmetric group; avoid computing Range or Image values, only images of a generator set; replace OnPoints with a custom function to avoid extra internal processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These tricks reduce memory and computation when dealing with extremely large groups, but they reduce automatic deduction and should be used only when standard approaches fail.

rubrics_metrics.name: NiceMonomorphism_requirement_and_use
rubrics_metrics.description: NiceMonomorphism(obj) is an attribute holding a homomorphism defined at least on obj and injective on obj; it is used to translate calculations into an isomorphic object with better algorithms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Domain of the homomorphism may be larger than obj; use NiceObject(obj) to get image. To use a known monomorphism, set it with SetNiceMonomorphism and mark injectivity via IsInjective or SetIsInjective to avoid expensive tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsHandledByNiceMonomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsHandledByNiceMonomorphism(obj) indicates that high-valued methods will translate computations for obj into the image under NiceMonomorphism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When true, GAP will use efficient methods available for the NiceObject representation; ensure NiceMonomorphism and related functions are correctly defined.

rubrics_metrics.name: NiceObject_semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: NiceObject(obj) returns the image of obj under its NiceMonomorphism; this is the concrete object used for translated computations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical example: finite matrix groups are translated into permutation groups via a NiceMonomorphism for faster algorithms.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCanonicalNiceMonomorphism_property
rubrics_metrics.description: IsCanonicalNiceMonomorphism(nhom): a nice monomorphism is canonical if its image set depends only on the set of group elements (not the generating set) and comparison of elements translates through it; not guaranteed for every nice monomorphism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canonicality may be expensive to achieve; if present, equal objects will always have equal NiceObject values, which is desirable for reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: group_automorphism_definitions_and_constructors
rubrics_metrics.description: Group automorphisms are bijective homomorphisms from a group onto itself; constructors include ConjugatorIsomorphism(G,g), ConjugatorAutomorphism(G,g)/NC, InnerAutomorphism(G,g)/NC; NC variants omit checks for normalization or membership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ConjugatorIsomorphism returns isomorphism G→G^g mapping h→h^g. ConjugatorAutomorphism requires g normalize G (omit check with NC). InnerAutomorphism requires g∈G (omit check with NC). Use NC variants only when the user can guarantee preconditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsConjugatorIsomorphism_IsConjugatorAutomorphism_IsInnerAutomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: Properties IsConjugatorIsomorphism(hom), IsConjugatorAutomorphism(hom), IsInnerAutomorphism(hom) test whether a given mapping/homomorphism is of the respective special type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these properties to detect/constrain automorphisms induced by conjugation or inner elements; useful for specialized algorithms that exploit conjugation structure.
